mapper.select: SELECT log.id, log.session_id, session.user_id, log.from_stage, log.to_stage, log.trigger_source, log.trigger_ref_id, log.note, log.create_time FROM career_loop_stage_log log INNER JOIN career_loop_session session ON session.id = log.session_id WHERE log.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY log.id DESC

SELECT session.user_id FROM career_loop_stage_log log INNER JOIN career_loop_session session ON session.id = log.session_id WHERE log.create_time >= #{createdAfter} GROUP BY session.user_id ORDER BY MAX(log.create_time) DESC, session.user_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
